corrections.reason: The 42 Golden42 rows are the per-dataset minimum RMSE over every valid evaluation in the combined evolution ledger (63,108 test-scored candidate evaluations), not the score of one program selected before the test targets were opened. This repository's own red-team lane names exactly that quantity: it declares the jope-dime baseline as the best-test ASPFM envelope over 63,108 Golden42 candidate evaluations with role oracle_reference_only, refuses any configuration that says otherwise, reads the value from the index's best_rmse, and keeps it out of the fair ladder while jope-dime-regressor, TabPFN v3 and TabFM are role fair. A minimum over test-scored candidates is a test-adaptive selection whatever each candidate was fitted on, so these rows are demoted. The reproducible fixed-seed run of the same engine (jope-dime-regressor, public-development) is untouched.
